stemMd: A writer is describing the sound of an old printing press in operation. Which detail most effectively serves that purpose?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The press can print a page in black ink.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Each turn of the wheel ends with a short metallic click and a low thump.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The press was purchased from a school.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The press occupies two square meters of floor space.

explanationMd: Match the requested sensory purpose to the detail. A metallic click and a low thump allow the reader to imagine the sound of the operating machine.

distractorRationale.d: The dimensions describe size rather than sound.
distractorRationale.c: Ownership history does not describe its sound.
distractorRationale.a: Ink color does not provide an auditory detail.
